question: What is the full form of DPI with regard to digital images?
solution:
The correct answer is __Dots per inch__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

 
• DPI stands for **Dots per inch**, which is a measure of spatial printing or video dot density.<
